scripts.generate: cd infiniteclothing && bunx --no-install sync-engine artifacts pin
scripts.check: cd infiniteclothing && bunx --no-install sync-engine check && bunx --no-install sync-engine artifacts check && bunx --no-install tsc --noEmit
scripts.check:design: cd infiniteclothing && bunx --no-install sync-engine check-design design/concepts/*.md design/types.md design/compositions/*.md
scripts.dev: bun run db:up && bun run --parallel dev:backend dev:frontend
scripts.up: podman compose up -d --build && bun scripts/check-api.ts http://127.0.0.1:8080 --wait
scripts.db:shell: podman compose exec mongo mongosh -u dev -p dev
